title: quassia laevis
intro: Quassia laevis, commonly known as Patagonian Quassia, is a plant species in the family Simaroubaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which help in treating conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Quassia laevis include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a natural insecticide. The bioactive constituents of Quassia laevis include quassin, quassinoid compounds, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
